title: When three walk together, there is surely a teacher for me
shortSummary: The saying places learning in companionship, discernment of strengths and self-correction.
curatorialDescription: The full passage includes both emulation and correction, not only a maxim about humility.
researchNote: Chapter numbering, early commentary and Tang interpretation require further verification.

sources.title: Received editions and chapter references for the Analects
sources.locator: 颜渊第十二，第1章（“克己复礼为仁”）
sources.role: Initial basis for the Confucian passage and chapter locator

profile.originalText: 三人行，必有我师焉。择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。
profile.punctuatedText: 三人行，必有我师焉。择其善者而从之，其不善者而改之。
profile.modernZh: 多人同行，其中一定有可作为我老师的人；选择其优点学习，见到不足则反省并改正自己。
profile.translationEn: When three walk together, there is surely a teacher for me: I follow what is good in them and correct in myself what is not.
